sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'h' AND b.bond_type = '#') AS filtered
